record.original_question: What is the asymptotic error $epsilon_m*$ as a function of $m$ and $delta$?

evidence.quote: What is the asymptotic error $\epsilon_m^*$ as a function of $m$ and $\delta$?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a parameter $\delta\in(0,1)$ and an integer $m\ge 1$, let $\mathcal{P}_m$ denote the set of real polynomials of degree at most $m$, and define the best uniform approximation error to the sign function on the symmetric two-interval set $[-1,-\delta]\cup[\delta,1]$ by
$$\epsilon_m^*(\delta)\;=\;\inf_{p\in\mathcal{P}_m}\;\sup_{x\in[-1,-\delta]\cup[\delta,1]}\bigl|\operatorname{sgn}(x)-p(x)\bigr|,$$
where $\operatorname{sgn}(x)=1$ for $x>0$ and $\operatorname{sgn}(x)=-1$ for $x<0$. Determine the precise asymptotic behavior of $\epsilon_m^*(\delta)$ as $m\to\infty$, as an explicit function of $m$ and $\delta$.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact asymptotic of the best uniform polynomial approximation error to $\operatorname{sgn}(x)$ on $[-1,-\delta]\cup[\delta,1]$ is known. Eremenko and Yuditskii established that $\epsilon_m^*(\delta)\sim \tfrac{1-\delta}{\sqrt{\pi\delta}}\cdot\tfrac{2}{\sqrt{m-1}}\bigl(\tfrac{1-\delta}{1+\delta}\bigr)^{(m-1)/2}$ as $m\to\infty$, with extremal polynomials described via conformal maps onto comb-like domains. The problem is therefore solved in the asymptotic sense.

status_evidence.title: Polynomials of the best uniform approximation to sgn(x) on two intervals
status_evidence.snippet: Extremal polynomials represented via conformal maps on comb-like domains; precise asymptotics for the minimal deviation are obtained.
status_evidence.claim: Eremenko–Yuditskii give the exact asymptotic of the minimax error for approximation of sgn on two symmetric intervals.

status_evidence.title: Uniform approximation of sgn x by polynomials and entire functions
status_evidence.claim: Explicit asymptotic constant for the best polynomial approximation error to sgn on [-1,-ε]∪[ε,1].
